functions.name: listen
functions.description: Opens a one-shot HTTP listener on the loopback interface and returns its port. The first GET to `/` is taken as the OAuth redirect.

functions.name: waitForRedirect
functions.description: Resolves with the full redirect URL (http://localhost:<port>/?code=…) once the browser lands on the listener. Rejects when the listener is closed or the timeout runs out.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: How long to wait before giving up.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Closes the listener, rejecting a pending waitForRedirect(). A no-op for an unknown port.
